findings.action: Human reviewer: spot-check the three new rows (claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-fable-5-1) and the 0.05x/0.025x cache-read multipliers against platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing before merging.
findings.disposition_rationale: The diff faithfully implements the spec's confirmed-rates table (reviewed line-by-line across all three files) and is additive + fully revertible, so by the revert test this is not a human-judgement blocker and the code review passes. The correctness of the rates against Anthropic's live published pricing cannot be verified code-blind; the spec's decision (decides: product) reserves that spot-check to a human at merge. Tracked as needs-human on AC items done:1-4, which keep all_verified=false and hold auto-merge, leaving the PR open for the human.
